Passenger vehicle with spark-ignition engine of 3,000cc falls under heading 8703. Subheading 8703.23 covers engines over 1,500cc but not over 3,000cc. The 3.0L engine (3,000cc) fits there. The statistical suffix for 8703.23.01 is divided by cylinder capacity and then by value: 8703.23.01 has 10-digit subdivisions: 8703.23.0160 for "Other" (new vehicles) and 8703.23.0190 for others. Specifically, 8703.23.01 breaks down as 8703.23.0110 (Passenger vehicles designed for transportation of persons, 4-wheel drive?), but I'm not certain. I recall 8703.23.01 has 8703.23.0160 (Other: Sedans/ station wagons?) and 8703.23.0190 (Other). Per CBP rulings for similar vehicles (e.g., a 2018 Audi S5 ruling), the classification given was 8703.23.0190, which is a common one for passenger cars with 1,500–3,000cc engines.
